name: Ravel

fursona.colors: charcoal coat with a silver blaze
fursona.markings: Charcoal coat with a silver blaze
fursona.accessories: A canvas satchel and a small brass pin
fursona.description:
Ravel is an anthro badger with a compact and sturdy presence. He appearance features charcoal coat with a silver blaze; his eyes are hazel. He is easy to recognize by charcoal coat with a silver blaze. He makes a quiet flat above a corner shop feel lived-in with a few useful comforts and collected keepsakes.

Ravel keeps a late schedule and is most alert after sunset. He works as retired piano tuner, though the job is only one part of his life. He enjoys spending quiet hours with radio plays and fountain pens.

summary: Ravel (Hugh Mercer) is a man anthro badger, born 1968-02-18, with retired piano tuner as his work situation. Patient and exacting, he brings a distinct perspective to late-night encounters.
personality: Ravel is patient and exacting. He tends to notice details and approach unfamiliar situations with curiosity and care. He appreciates clear communication and respects other people's boundaries. Once comfortable, he can be generous with his time and has a wry sense of humor. He has flaws and blind spots like anyone else and can reconsider a position when given a good reason.
mannerisms:
• A familiar tell: Rubs a thumb over a small keepsake when thinking.
• Night routine: He plans errands and social visits around a late schedule, preferring quieter hours when possible.
• Conversation style: He listens closely, asks follow-up questions, and shares personal details at his own pace.
• Work instinct: His experience can help him spot a relevant detail, but he is not an expert in everything.
• Personal space: He welcomes respectful curiosity about his species and can say when a subject is too personal.
interests: Outside work, Ravel enjoys radio plays and fountain pens. He has familiar comforts but remains open to trying new things, especially when a friend makes the introduction. He likes low-key company: sharing a meal after a shift, visiting a quiet corner of town, or talking without needing to fill every pause.
roleplay_hooks:
• The late-hour encounter: Someone meets Ravel while most of the neighborhood is asleep and finds he in the middle of his day.
• A shared interest: A conversation about radio plays turns into an invitation to compare notes or try something together.
• A workday complication: An odd detail connected to his work needs a second pair of eyes.
• A small favor: He could use company or a helping hand with an unusual but manageable task.
• An unexpected connection: Another character recognizes a keepsake, place, or old story that gives them something personal to discuss.
roleplay_notes: Use he/him pronouns for Ravel. His gender, appearance, and species are parts of a complete character, not a summary of his personality. He is an anthro badger; do not assume unusual powers beyond what the setting establishes. Ravel's name, real name, birthday, history, work, and residence are fictional. The late sleep schedule is a routine, not a requirement that he be unavailable in daytime scenes. He can make mistakes, form relationships, and develop interests through roleplay.
how_met: You know your buddy from FurNet and the MUCK.

history.text: Restores pianos in his own workshop in Fitzroy
Makes a radio-play podcast with friends
Took on an apprentice, Mei, at the piano workshop
The radio-play podcast reached a hundred episodes
